info.title: Skyline.DataMiner.QAOps
info.description: The main external access point for external users and pipelines to manipulate QAOps.

x-inspectra.cliParsedDescription: The main external access point for external users and pipelines to manipulate QAOps..

options.name: --debug
options.description: Indicates the tool should write out debug logging.

options.name: --minimum-log-level
options.description: Indicates what the minimum log level should be. Default is Information

commands.name: test-run-and-wait
commands.description: Run a test suite and wait on completion. Exit codes: 0 = all tests passed, 1 = run failed, 2 = timeout, 3 = run completed but tests failed, 4 = run cancelled.

options.name: --hotfix-id
options.description: Optionally provide a hotfix identifier returned after uploading one.

options.name: --storage-account-name
options.description: Optionally provide a storage account name to use.

options.name: --tags
options.description: Optionally provide a semi-colon separated list of tags.

options.name: --label
options.description: Optionally provide a label as 'key=value'. Can be specified multiple times. Labels have no meaning for QAOps itself, they are passed through unchanged to the test package (environment variable 'QAOPS_TEST_RUN_LABELS'). Labels are stored together with the tags of the test run.

options.name: --token
options.description: Token provided by the QAOps service. Can also be provided via an environment variable: 'QAOPS_TOKEN'

options.name: --test-packages
options.description: Optionally provide one or more test packages that need to run instead of the configured packages in the test suite. Mutually exclusive with '--override-test-packages' and '--override-test-package-versions'.

options.name: --supplementary-files
options.description: Optionally provide one or more supplementary files that will be made available inside 'PathToTestPackageContent\SupplementaryFiles'.

options.name: --override-test-packages
options.description: Optionally provide one or more test packages that need to be overwritten in the test suite. Mutually exclusive with '--test-packages'.

options.name: --override-test-package-versions
options.description: Optionally override one or more test packages their configured version in the test suite. Mutually exclusive with '--test-packages'. '--override-test-packages' has priority above these overrides.

options.name: --testsuite-id
options.description: The unique identifier of the QAOps Test Suite to run.

options.name: --configuration-id
options.description: The unique identifier of the QAOps Configuration to run this Test Suite on.

options.name: --result-filepath
options.description: Filepath to store a .json with results. If the file exists it will be overwritten.

options.name: --timeout-in-seconds
options.description: Maximum time in seconds to wait on finish results.

commands.name: report-external-check
commands.description: Submit versioned evidence for exactly one gate-owned External Source.

options.name: --status
options.description: OK, WARNING or FAIL.

options.name: --message
options.description: Plain-text report explanation.

options.name: --report-id
options.description: Stable report ULID for retries; generated once when omitted.

options.name: --observed-at-utc
options.description: Observation UTC time; generated once when omitted.

options.name: --result-link
options.description: Optional HTTPS evidence locator.

options.name: --token
options.description: QAOps token; defaults to QAOPS_TOKEN.

options.name: --tenant-id
options.description: Azure tenant; defaults to QAOPS_TENANT_ID or the existing QAOps tenant.

options.name: --storage-account-name
options.description: Defaults to QAOPS_STORAGE_ACCOUNT_NAME or saqaops.

options.name: --wait-seconds
options.description: Bounded receipt wait (1-300 seconds). A timeout is not rejection; retry the same report.
